contract:
use-mobile-tour.ts:
- CAMPUS_STEPS (:87-104) replaced by:
  * {selector "#otto-mobile-tour-tabs", title "Everything's one swipe away.", body "Feed, Events, Orgs, Chat, and the Map. Swipe or tap to switch."}
  * {selector "#otto-mobile-tour-feed", title "The campus feed.", body "What students at {campus} are posting. People you follow rise to the top."} with fallback body when no campus: "What students on your campus are posting. People you follow rise to the top."
  * {selector "#otto-mobile-tour-compose", title "Your turn.", body "Tap + to post text, photos, or video.", endLabel "Got it"}
- HANDOFFS.campus (:129) → {next:null, dest:null}. PROFILE and NETWORK legs are unchanged.
- Start condition (:177-183): read pending and seen inside try/catch; a storage failure means pending=null, seen=false. welcome = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("welcome") === "1". Start when pending === leg || (leg === "campus" && welcome && seen !== "1"). If leg === "campus" && welcome && seen === "1" && pending !== "campus" → stripWelcomeParam() and return.
- Campus-name resolution, campus leg only, after the script loads and before OttoTour.start: fetch("/api/me/onboarding-state", {cache:"no-store", credentials:"same-origin", signal}) with a 1500ms AbortController timeout. campus = campusRowById(j?.campus_id)?.shortName ?? null. Materialise steps with .replace("{campus}", campus) or the fallback body. Any failure uses the fallback. The name is never read from the URL.
- Import campusRowById from @/lib/iu/campuses (client-safe).

NetworkMobile.tsx:
- ListUser (:29-43) gains reason_v2?: "from_your_clubs"|"same_campus"|"same_major"|"same_system"|"mutuals"|"new_on_vibe"; campus_id?: string|null; school_system?: "iu"|"purdue"|null.
- SuggestionCategory (:937) = "org"|"campus"|"major"|"mutuals"|"system"|"new".
- categorizeSuggestion (:939-945): when reason_v2 is present map from_your_clubs→org, same_campus→campus, same_major→major, same_system→system, mutuals→mutuals, new_on_vibe→new. Else the legacy logic, with the literal "same school" → campus (kept for one release so a stale response still groups).
- SUGGESTION_GROUP_ORDER (:620-631), in order:
  * org "From your clubs" / "Members of orgs you're already in"
  * campus label "At {campus}" (campus = campusRowById(first user in bucket .campus_id)?.shortName; fallback "On your campus") / "On campus, not yet in your circle"
  * major "Same major" / "Other students studying what you study"
  * mutuals "Friends of friends" / "People your connections know"
  * system label "Elsewhere at {IU|Purdue}" (SYSTEM_LABEL[first.school_system]; fallback "Elsewhere at your university") / "Same university, another campus"
  * new "New on Vibe" / "Just joined"
  The bucket init (:666-672) matches the six keys. Labels become computed per render.
- SuggestionReason (:947-960): campus → "At {campus}" (fallback "On your campus"); system → "Elsewhere at {IU|Purdue}"; others unchanged.
- Discover empty body (:586) → "We'll suggest people once more students on your campus join Vibe, or once you've joined a club or two."
- UserRow label (:826) "Connect" → "Follow" (one-way follow; see openQuestions #8). Update the docblock line :24.

CampusMobile.tsx: EXACTLY two edits, so F5b can land after without conflict:
- (a) EventsPane empty body (:1484) → "When orgs or classmates create events, they'll surface here."
- (b) import CampusConfirmBanner and render `<CampusConfirmBanner />` immediately before `<header id="otto-mobile-tour-tabs"` (:466-467).
- Do NOT touch OrgsPane/OrgRow/Org type/refetchOrgs (:56-65, :251-269, :2311-2393). The orgs empty state (:2327) belongs to F5b.

CampusConfirmBanner.tsx (new, client):
- On mount, vibeRequest("/api/me/onboarding-state", {cache:"no-store", quiet:true, failure:"Couldn't load your campus."}). Failure → render nothing.
- Hidden unless data.school_verified && data.school_system && !data.campus_confirmed, and sessionStorage "vibe_campus_confirm_dismissed" !== "1" (try/catch).
- campus_id set: title "Confirm your campus", body "Is {shortName} still right?", buttons "Yes" and "Change" (Link /settings#campus), plus a "Not now" text button (sets the sessionStorage key and hides).
  * Yes → vibeRequest("/api/me/profile", {method:"PATCH", json:{campus_id}, quiet:true, failure:"Couldn't confirm your campus."}). ok → hide plus toast "Campus confirmed.". Fail → toast r.message with action.
- campus_id null: title "Pick your campus", body "Your campus decides the clubs, events and map you see.", button "Pick campus" (Link /settings#campus) plus "Not now".
- Light card style matching CampusMobile's cream palette. Buttons min 44px.
acceptance: rg -n 'Pull to refresh later|Around your school|"Connect"|Posts from people you follow, ranked' src/components/mobile → 0.
git diff --stat on CampusMobile.tsx shows only the import, the banner mount and the EventsPane line (at most 3 hunks).

375×812 on prod /campus?welcome=1 after removing ONLY localStorage vibe_campus_tour_seen_v1 in-page (no server writes): three bubbles; the second reads 'What students at Indianapolis are posting. People you follow rise to the top.'; 'Got it' ends the tour with no navigation to /network; vibe_campus_tour_seen_v1 === '1'; the URL no longer has welcome=1.
Same with an onboarding-state override that returns 500: the second bubble shows the fallback body.

Network Discover at 375×812 with a suggested-connections override returning one row per reason_v2 (campus_id 'indianapolis', school_system 'purdue' for the system row): groups render in order with labels 'From your clubs', 'At Indianapolis', 'Same major', 'Friends of friends', 'Elsewhere at Purdue', 'New on Vibe'. A second override with no reason_v2 and reason 'same school' still lands in 'At Indianapolis' or 'On your campus'.

Banner screenshots with onboarding-state overrides (unconfirmed plus campus; verified with no campus; confirmed → no banner). 'Yes' is only tapped with the non-GET fetch blocker installed (records one PATCH, sends nothing).
